Name: Torishiki
Address (JA): 東京都品川区上大崎2-14-12
Notes: Omakase-only yakitori at a 12-seat counter, where chef Yoshiteru Ikegawa grills free-range Date chicken from Fukushima; a Michelin star since 2010. Very hard to book: seats open two months out, and your best shot is calling (03-3440-7656) on the first service day of the month. Two minutes from Meguro Station's east exit.

Name: Yakitori Abe
Address (JA): 東京都品川区上大崎3-3-4 MIYUKI HOUSE 1F
Notes: Torishiki's sister restaurant: Date chicken grilled over Kishu binchotan, with about 60 wines; Michelin Bib Gourmand and Tabelog Yakitori EAST 100 2025. The easier way into the Torishiki style, at about ¥6,000 for dinner. Four minutes on foot from Meguro Station; phone 03-5422-9834.

Name: BIRD LAND
Hours: 17:00–22:00 (last order 21:30); closed Sundays, Mondays and holidays (OpenTable shows Tue–Sat 17:00–21:30)
Address (JA): 東京都中央区銀座4-2-15 塚本素山ビルB1
Notes: Michelin calls it a pioneer of course-style yakitori; known for liver pâté, oyakodon and rare cuts. Tabelog Yakitori EAST 100 2025. Bookable on OpenTable, which is easy for visitors.

Name: Toranomon Yakitori Kuniyoshi
Address (JA): ~東京都港区虎ノ門一丁目
Notes: A Tabelog Yakitori EAST 100 pick (3.69), with a set course at ¥14,800 plus 10% service. Booking is online only. It's in a basement, five minutes from Toranomon Station.

Name: Yakitori Imai
Address (JA): 東京都渋谷区神宮前3-42-11 ローザビアンカ1F
Notes: Counter yakitori from Tamba jidori, Akadori and Okukuji shamo, with natural wines; Michelin Bib Gourmand and Tabelog EAST 100 2025. Dinner is about ¥8,000. Phone 03-6447-1710.

Name: Isehiro Kyobashi Honten
Hours: Lunch 11:30–14:00; dinner 17:00–21:00 (Saturday dinner only, to 20:30); closed Sundays and holidays
Address (JA): 東京都中央区京橋1-4-9
Notes: Grilling yakitori since 1921; Tabelog Yakitori EAST 100 2025 (3.67). Weekday lunch is a cheap yakitori-don from ¥1,600. Phone 03-3281-5864.

Name: Shutei Tanaka
Address (JA): 東京都墨田区墨田3-25-7
Notes: Two brothers serve a salt-forward set course that ends with oyakodon, in two seatings; a new Michelin Bib Gourmand for 2026, at a mid-range price. Book online through omakase.in or TableCheck, or call 03-3617-6615. Older guides call it 鳥田中.

Name: Fuunji
Address (JA): ~東京都渋谷区代々木二丁目
Notes: Tokyo's benchmark thick chicken-and-fish tsukemen; Tabelog 3.76, Ramen 100 2025. Buy a ticket from the machine; queues at peak times.

Name: Rokurinsha
Hours: 7:30–10:00 (last order 9:30, morning menu); 10:00–23:00 (last order 22:30); follows the complex's closed days
Address (JA): 東京都千代田区丸の内1-9-1 東京駅一番街 B1F 東京ラーメンストリート内
Notes: The famous rich tsukemen of Tokyo Station's Ramen Street, down in the basement; Tabelog 3.77, Ramen 100 2025. Come for the early-morning menu or mid-afternoon to avoid the line.

Name: Raa Menya Shima
Address (JA): 東京都渋谷区本町3-41-12
Notes: One of Tokyo's highest-rated ramen shops (Tabelog Award 2026 Bronze), so expect a very long wait. Seats can be booked on TableCheck, released the day before.

Name: Sosakumenkobo Nakiryu
Address (JA): 東京都豊島区南大塚2-34-4 SKY南大塚1F
Notes: Tantanmen with sesame paste, chili oil and black vinegar; once Michelin-starred, now a Bib Gourmand. Numbered tickets are handed out from 8:00.

Name: Mendokoro Honda
Address (JA): 東京都千代田区神田花岡町1-19
Notes: A Ramen 100 2025 shop (Tabelog 3.81) under the railway arches, 40 m from Akihabara Station. It moved here from Higashi-Jujo.

Name: Ginza Haru Chan Ramen
Address (JA): 東京都中央区銀座3-11-6
Notes: Clear, salty pork broth with dried fish; a new Michelin Bib Gourmand for 2026. It's a small shop with lunch lines, but it serves straight through the day, so come off-peak.

Name: Tempura Kondo
Hours: Lunch 12:00–15:00 (last order 13:30); dinner 17:00–20:30; closed Sundays (and Mondays that are holidays)
Address (JA): 東京都中央区銀座5-5-13 坂口ビル9F
Notes: Two Michelin stars (2026), famous for its vegetable tempura. Lunch is ¥10–15k, dinner ¥20–30k. Book about a month ahead, often through a hotel concierge; phone 03-5568-0923.

Name: Kyobashi Tempura Fukamachi
Address (JA): 東京都中央区京橋2-5-2 A・M京橋ビル1F
Notes: Seasonal omakase, frying vegetables and seafood at different temperatures; Michelin 1 star (2026), Tabelog Tempura 100 2025. Lunch (about ¥10–15k) is the better value.

Name: Mikawa Zezankyo
Hours: Lunch 11:30–13:30; dinner from 17:00 (last order 19:30); closed Wednesdays
Address (JA): 東京都江東区福住1-3-1
Notes: Edomae tempura from veteran chef Tetsuya Saotome (founded 1976); Tabelog Tempura 100 2025. Get the kakiage with rice. Eight minutes on foot from Monzen-Nakacho Station; phone 03-3643-8383.

Name: Tempura Shinjuku Tsunahachi
Address (JA): ~東京都新宿区新宿三丁目
Notes: Long-running counter tempura; the lunch sets with rice, pickles and clam miso soup are good value. It has several branches, and the Shinjuku flagship is the one to visit.

Name: Kaneko Hannosuke
Address (JA): ~東京都中央区日本橋室町一丁目
Notes: Cult tendon of shrimp, squid kakiage and nori at about ¥1,400. Lines up to 90+ minutes; the Nihonbashi original is the one to visit.

Name: Tensuke
Address (JA): ~東京都杉並区高円寺北三丁目
Notes: Michelin Bib Gourmand 2026; the signature is a tempura egg over rice, served with a showy egg-cracking routine. Cheap; lunch queues.

Name: Dote no Iseya
Address (JA): ~東京都台東区日本堤一丁目
Notes: Tendon shop founded 1889, with I/Ro/Ha grades (¥2,300–3,300); go for Ro or Ha. Long weekend queues, so go early on a weekday.

Name: Nihao
Address (JA): ~東京都大田区蒲田四丁目
Notes: The shop that invented hanetsuki (winged) gyoza, in 1983; Tabelog Dumplings 100. Cash only, three minutes from JR Kamata Station.

Name: Okei
Address (JA): ~東京都千代田区富士見二丁目
Notes: Gyoza specialist since 1954; past Bib Gourmand, Dumplings 100 2024. Dinner on weekdays plus Saturday lunch; no reservations, cash only.

Name: Kameido Gyoza Honten
Address (JA): ~東京都江東区亀戸五丁目
Notes: Old-school 1953 shop with almost only gyoza and beer on the menu; Dumplings 100 2024. Fast turnover; closed Tuesdays.

Name: Asia Kappou Rengetsu
Address (JA): ~東京都港区南青山一丁目
Notes: Handmade Japanese-Chinese gyoza, both pan-fried pork and boiled lamb; Dumplings 100 2024 (#13). Often crowded.

Name: Harajuku Gyozaro
Address (JA): ~東京都渋谷区神宮前六丁目
Notes: Famously cheap fried or steamed gyoza at a counter; an easy stop while shopping.

Name: Monja Kondo Honten
Address (JA): ~東京都中央区月島三丁目
Notes: Said to have served monja since just after WWII; half portions let you try several. Tabelog 3.49.

Name: Tsukishima Monja Moheji Honten
Hours: Weekdays lunch 10:45-15:00, dinner 17:00-23:00; Sat, Sun, holidays 10:30-23:00
Address (JA): ~東京都中央区月島一丁目
Notes: Monja from a shop run by a seafood wholesaler: try the mentaiko-mochi or the squid-ink monja. The counter grills suit solo diners; Tabelog 3.56. Four minutes on foot from Tsukishima Station.

Name: Hantei
Hours: Lunch 11:30–15:00 (last order 14:15); dinner 17:00–22:00 (last order 21:00); closed Mondays (Tuesday if Monday is a holiday); on Sundays it may close early when ingredients run out
Address (JA): 東京都文京区根津2-12-15
Notes: Set kushiage in a 100+ year-old wooden house that is a registered cultural property; lunch 8 skewers ~¥3,600, dinner 12 ~¥5,500. Reserve via TableCheck; closed Mondays.

Name: Onigiri Bongo
Address (JA): 東京都豊島区北大塚2-27-5
Notes: Onigiri made to order since 1960, loosely packed, with more than 50 fillings. Arrive at least 30 minutes before opening.

Name: Onigiri Asakusa Yadoroku
Hours: Lunch from 11:30 and dinner from 17:00, until the rice runs out
Address (JA): 東京都台東区浅草3-9-10
Notes: Tokyo's oldest onigiri shop (1954), with Koshihikari rice cooked in a hagama pot; Michelin Bib Gourmand.

Name: Onigiri Yamataro
Hours: 11:00–15:00 and 16:45–18:30 (weekend evenings to 20:00); irregular days off
Address (JA): 東京都豊島区雑司が谷2-10-7
Notes: A Bongo-trained chef makes generous two-filling onigiri, with a signature tonjiru (pork miso soup). Days off are irregular, so check Instagram (@yamataro_onigiri) before you go.

Name: Onigiri Togoshiya
Address (JA): 東京都品川区戸越2-5-3
Notes: Tsuyahime rice, 40+ made-to-order fillings, and signature karaage. Pair with a walk down the Togoshi Ginza shopping street.

Name: Tamahide
Address (JA): 東京都中央区日本橋人形町1-17-10
Notes: Founded in 1760 and credited with inventing oyakodon; reopened in November 2025 after a renovation. The original oyakodon (¥2,800) is made with Tokyo shamo chicken.

Name: Koharuken
Hours: 11:00-14:00, 17:00-20:00; closed Sundays and holidays, Saturday afternoon uncertain
Address (JA): 東京都中央区日本橋人形町1-7-9
Notes: Yoshoku house from 1912 serving its original katsudon with demi-glace (¥1,300). Weekdays only; 2 minutes from Tamahide.

Name: Nihonbashi Kaisendon Tsujihan
Address (JA): 東京都中央区日本橋3-1-15 久栄ビル1F
Notes: Piled seafood bowl; save some for the sea-bream broth to finish it as ochazuke. Waits up to 2 hours, so go late afternoon.

Name: Komefuku
Address (JA): 東京都渋谷区恵比寿西1-4-2 川田ビルB1F
Notes: Rice-variety tasting restaurant: about 30 varieties a year, five at a time, each donabe-cooked to order. English menu; 3 minutes from JR Ebisu. Top pick for regional rices.

Name: AKOMEYA Shokudo Kagurazaka
Address (JA): ~東京都新宿区矢来町
Notes: A rice retailer's restaurant cooking rice from around Japan in iron hagama, with regional set meals. Buy the same rice in the shop.

Name: Salon Ginza Sabou
Address (JA): 東京都中央区銀座5-2-1 東急プラザ銀座B2F
Notes: Prize-winning Yukihotaka Koshihikari cooked in Iga-ware donabe; build-your-own teishoku.

Name: Ikushika
Address (JA): 東京都渋谷区宇田川町15-1 渋谷PARCO B1
Notes: Affordable sets with Fukushima rice cooked in donabe and held in wooden ohitsu; free refills.

Name: Kamameshi Haru Asakusa Honten
Hours: 11:00-21:00 (last order 20:00); generally closed Wednesdays, varies by month; weekday food orders paused 14:30-16:00 from 1 June 2026
Address (JA): 東京都台東区浅草1-14-9
Notes: Iron-pot kamameshi since 1926 (crab, shrimp, scallop); about 20 minutes per pot. English menu; near Senso-ji.

Name: Fukagawajuku
Hours: Weekdays 11:30–15:00 and 17:00–21:00; weekends and holidays 11:30–17:00 (last orders 30 minutes before closing)
Address (JA): 東京都江東区三好1-6-7
Notes: Tokyo clam rice served both ways: bukkake (broth over rice) and takikomi (cooked in). This main shop is by Kiyosumi-Shirakawa; the Tomioka Hachiman branch in Monzen-Nakacho serves dinner only.

Name: Choju-an Kyosho
Hours: 11:30-14:30 (Mon-Sat and holidays), 17:30-20:00 (Mon-Sat, until soba sells out); closed Sundays
Address (JA): 東京都江東区平野1-7-2
Notes: A soba shop whose Fukagawa set combines soba, a small bowl of clam rice and seasonal tempura.

Name: Tonkatsu Narikura
Hours: Lunch 11:00-14:00, dinner 17:30-20:00, fully reservation-only; irregular days off
Address (JA): 東京都杉並区成田東4-33-9
Notes: Pale "blonde" low-temperature-fried cutlets; Tabelog 4.29, Award 2026 Bronze. Reservation only, served in fixed seatings, so be on time. About ¥6,500–8,000.

Name: Tonkatsu Tonki
Address (JA): 東京都目黒区下目黒1-1-2
Notes: Frying since 1939, with a long counter around an open kitchen. The rosu or hire set is ¥2,300, and the tonjiru is a highlight. No reservations.

Name: Tonkatsu Marugo
Address (JA): ~東京都千代田区外神田一丁目
Notes: Thick, tender pork in a crunchy crust; Tabelog 3.74, Tonkatsu 100 2026. Good value (¥1–2k).

Name: Tonkatsu Nanaido
Address (JA): 東京都渋谷区神宮前3-42-11 ローザビアンカ1F
Notes: Tokyo's #2 tonkatsu by Tabelog score (3.98).

Name: Butagumi
Address (JA): ~東京都港区六本木七丁目
Notes: Menu of branded pork breeds at different prices; Tonkatsu 100 2026. Closed Mondays and the 2nd and 4th Tuesday.

Name: Tonkatsu Maisen Aoyama Honten
Address (JA): 東京都渋谷区神宮前4-8-5
Notes: Chain flagship and the classic reference point; known for katsu sando to take away. Easy to get into, but rated lower than the specialists.

Name: Gyukatsu Motomura
Address (JA): 東京都渋谷区渋谷3-18-10 大野ビル2号館 B1F
Notes: A chain, but the reference point for gyukatsu: you sear the rare breaded beef yourself on a mini grill at the table. Tabelog only rates it 3.26, so pick whichever branch has the shortest line.

Name: Gyukatsu Aona
Address (JA): 東京都台東区上野6-5-7 JUNビル1階
Notes: Very rare wagyu gyukatsu in 200 g portions, with free rice refills. Unlike most gyukatsu shops, it takes reservations.

Name: Asakusa Gyukatsu
Address (JA): ~東京都台東区雷門二丁目
Notes: Crisp beef cutlet at mid-range prices (Tabelog 3.45); handy near Senso-ji.

Name: Kabuto
Address (JA): 東京都豊島区池袋2-53-2
Notes: Tabelog's top unagi in Tokyo (4.43, Award 2026 Silver): a counter course of eel skewers that uses every part of the eel. Seatings are reservation-only, so book months ahead. This is the shop on Ikebukuro's west side, not the Omoide Yokocho stall.

Name: Unagi Uomasa
Address (JA): ~東京都葛飾区東四つ木四丁目
Notes: Tabelog 4.29, Award 2026 Silver: a daily eel course including liver and kurikara-yaki. Reserve only via its official site; no children under 7.

Name: Nodaiwa
Address (JA): 東京都港区東麻布1-5-4
Notes: Edo-era house, Kanto style (steamed then grilled); Michelin 1 star; its 97-year-old chef won the Michelin Mentor Award 2026. Try the shirayaki (unsauced) with caviar.

Name: Unagi Obana
Address (JA): ~東京都荒川区南千住五丁目
Notes: Meiji-era Edo-style unagi-ya with a big tatami room; unaju ¥4–5.3k; Tabelog 3.77. Grilled to order (30+ minute wait); closed Mondays.

Name: Yaesu Unagi Hashimoto
Hours: Weekdays 11:00–14:30 and 17:00–20:30; Sat 11:30–15:00; holidays 11:00–15:00; closed Sundays
Address (JA): 東京都中央区八重洲1-5-10
Notes: Counter seats where you watch the eel get cut, steamed and grilled; Tabelog 3.94, Michelin Bib Gourmand. Near Tokyo Station.

Name: Watabe
Hours: 11:30–14:00 (last order 13:30) and 17:00–21:00 (last order 20:00); closed Wednesdays and Thursdays, Dec 31–Jan 4; extra closures (e.g. Tuesdays in Nov, Dec, Feb, Jan) posted on their calendar
Address (JA): 東京都文京区小石川1-9-14
Notes: The Enma-ju puts sauced and unsauced eel in one box; Tabelog 4.06, Michelin Bib Gourmand. Book on TableCheck or Tabelog, since the phone is hard to get through to.

Name: Akasaka Raimon
Address (JA): ~東京都港区赤坂五丁目
Notes: The splurge: yakiniku rated 4.54 on Tabelog, with a Tabelog Award 2026 Gold, at ¥15–20k. Reservations are very hard to get.

Name: Yoroniku
Address (JA): 東京都港区南青山6-6-22 ルナロッサ地下1階
Notes: Prix-fixe courses with slim chateaubriand and wagyu with truffle, dishes rivals later copied; Time Out calls it essential. Tabelog 3.79 (the Ebisu branch scores 4.25). About ¥10–15k.

Name: Yakiniku Jumbo Shirokane
Hours: Mon–Fri 17:00–23:00 (last order 22:00); Sat, Sun, holidays 11:30–14:30 (last order 14:00) and 17:00–23:00; closed Dec 31–Jan 2
Address (JA): 東京都港区白金3-1-1 第一麻布ビル1F
Notes: Order the nohara-yaki (thin, lightly seared sirloin), zabuton, misuji and garlic rice; Yakiniku 100 2025. Book via TableCheck.

Name: Yakiniku Ushigoro
Address (JA): ~東京都中央区銀座一丁目
Notes: Polished wagyu yakiniku (Tabelog 100 2026); easier to book than the top tier. About ¥8–15k.

Name: Yakiniku Tetsu
Address (JA): ~東京都新宿区西新宿一丁目
Notes: Good-value wagyu yakiniku, a Tabelog 100 2026 pick: dinner runs ¥6–8k, lunch ¥3–4k.

Name: Ningyocho Imahan Honten
Address (JA): ~東京都中央区日本橋人形町二丁目
Notes: A century-old beef house that goes back to gyu-nabe, the forerunner of sukiyaki; classic sukiyaki, Hot Pot 100 2026. Lunch, at ¥5–6k, is good value. Book on TableCheck or call 03-3666-7006, and check the site's closed-days notice for November and December.

Name: Sukiyaki Kappou Hiyama
Address (JA): ~東京都中央区日本橋人形町二丁目
Notes: Sukiyaki from a restaurant with its own butcher attached; Tabelog 3.70, Hot Pot 100 2026.

Name: Chinya
Hours: Mon–Fri 11:00–15:00 and 16:30–21:30; Sat, Sun, holidays 11:00–21:30 (last order 20:00); regular closed days not listed
Address (JA): 東京都台東区花川戸2-16-1
Notes: Long-running Asakusa sukiyaki house; Hot Pot 100 2026. Lunch from about ¥3,000.

Name: subin
Address (JA): ~東京都中央区銀座五丁目
Notes: Tokyo's top-rated hot-pot restaurant on Tabelog (4.15+), with a Tabelog Award 2026 Bronze. A big splurge, and hard to book.

Name: Zakuro
Address (JA): ~東京都中央区銀座四丁目
Notes: Long-standing shabu-shabu and sukiyaki house; lunch about ¥2–3k is a good value.

Name: Imafuku
Address (JA): 東京都港区白金1-12-19
Notes: Upscale wagyu shabu-shabu and sukiyaki; Hot Pot 100 2024. Expect ¥15–20k.

Name: Sembikiya Sohonten
Address (JA): 東京都中央区日本橋室町2-1-2 日本橋三井タワー1F
Notes: Japan's premium fruit house since 1834: sit at the 2nd-floor counter and watch the parfaits cut by hand. Strawberry season is just starting in mid-December. Book on Sembikiya's own reservation page (sembikiya.take-eats.jp) or call the parlor on 03-3241-1630.

Name: Takano Fruit Parlour
Hours: 11:00–21:00 (last order 20:30); temporarily 11:00–20:00 (last order 19:30) until further notice; closed days not listed
Address (JA): 東京都新宿区新宿3-26-11 5F
Notes: Classic fruit parlor on the 5th floor of Shinjuku Takano, plus a parfait counter on B2. About ¥2,000; 5 minutes from Shinjuku Station.

Name: Shiseido Parlour Ginza
Hours: Tue–Sat 11:00–21:00; Sun and holidays 11:00–20:00; closed Mondays (open if holiday) and New Year
Address (JA): 東京都中央区銀座8-8-3 東京銀座資生堂ビル3F
Notes: Parlor since 1902; signature strawberry parfait. Often a queue.

Name: Nishimura Fruits Parlour
Hours: 10:30–21:00 (L.O. 20:20); Sundays and holidays from 10:00; open daily
Address (JA): 東京都渋谷区宇田川町22-2 西村ビル2F
Notes: A fruit parlour since 1936: get the strawberry parfait with Tochiotome berries, jam and sorbet. The parlour is on the 2nd floor, above the fruit shop.

Name: Ichiman
Address (JA): ~東京都世田谷区宮坂三丁目
Notes: A Saitama strawberry farmer's own shop selling his berries and a mini strawberry parfait. 1 minute from Kyodo Station; closed Mondays.

Name: Okutan Nanzenji
Address (JA): ~京都府京都市左京区南禅寺福地町
Notes: A yudofu house dating from the Edo period; the set adds tempura, tofu dengaku and sesame tofu. Yudofu is a winter dish, so December is the perfect time for it.

Name: Nanzenji Junsei
Address (JA): ~京都府京都市左京区南禅寺福地町
Notes: Yudofu and yuba courses (about ¥4,840) in a large strolling garden around a cultural-property building. Lunch and dinner.

Name: Shoraian
Address (JA): ~京都府京都市右京区嵯峨亀ノ尾町
Notes: Private tatami rooms on a hillside above the Oi River; tofu courses with yuba. Reserve well ahead; dirt path and steps to reach it.

Name: Yudofu Sagano
Address (JA): ~京都府京都市右京区嵯峨天龍寺芒ノ馬場町
Notes: Yudofu sets near Tenryuji in a sukiya-style building with a garden view.

Name: Seizan Sodo
Address (JA): ~京都府京都市右京区嵯峨天龍寺造路町
Notes: A single yudofu set (¥3,850) made with Morika's Saga tofu, all vegetarian.

Name: Seigenin
Address (JA): ~京都府京都市右京区龍安寺御陵ノ下町
Notes: Vegetarian "seven-herb" yudofu on the Ryoanji grounds, looking onto a garden.

Name: Uchida Tsukemono
Address (JA): ~京都府京都市下京区長刀鉾町
Notes: More than 50 pickles to choose from at any time; the signature is Kyo-no-sato shibazuke.

Name: Murakami Ju Honten
Address (JA): ~京都府京都市下京区真町
Notes: A long-established Kyoto pickle shop for senmaizuke (in season in winter), shibazuke and turnip pickles.

Name: Kyoto Narita
Address (JA): ~京都府京都市北区小山北上総町
Notes: An Edo-era suguki maker: native Kamigamo turnips pickled with salt only. The new batch comes out in December, so your timing is right. There's no eat-in, so buy to take home, and pair it with Kamigamo Shrine.

Name: Shibakyu
Address (JA): 京都府京都市左京区大原勝林院町58
Notes: An Ohara shibazuke specialist (eggplant, red shiso, myoga), and an easy stop with Sanzen-in.

Name: Kamado Takitate Gohan Doi
Address (JA): ~京都府京都市下京区東塩小路釜殿町
Notes: Run by Doi Shibazuke of Ohara: all-you-can-eat seasonal pickles and obanzai with kamado-cooked rice. Good before a train.

Name: Kintame
Hours: Ochazuke kaiseki lunch 11:00–13:50 (last order 13:00); closed irregularly, and for a period in December
Address (JA): 京都府京都市上京区千本通五辻上ル牡丹鉾町576
Notes: A pickle maker since 1879. Lunch is a bubucha-zuke set of a dozen-plus pickles, grilled fish, miso soup and rice, served in the back room of the main store on Senbon-dori. Reservations required; the lunch closes for part of December, so check the site's notice for your dates.

Name: Ichihana
Address (JA): 京都府京都市中京区二条油小路町264-1
Notes: Kamameshi cooked to order with seasonal toppings (oyster in winter); Michelin Bib Gourmand.

Name: Hisago
Hours: 11:30–19:30 (last order 19:15); closed Mondays (next day if a holiday)
Address (JA): 京都府京都市東山区下河原通八坂鳥居前下ル下河原町484
Notes: Cheap, beloved oyakodon (¥980) on the temple circuit, with an English menu. Expect a line at lunch. It's at Yasaka Torii-mae on Shimokawara-dori, a few minutes from Kodaiji.

Name: Gochisou Yakimusubi Onimaru
Address (JA): ~京都府京都市下京区真町
Notes: A small chain, but the best yaki onigiri I found: rice cooked in a cauldron, then grilled over binchotan. Cash only.

Name: Menya Gokkei
Hours: 11:30–22:00 (closes early when the soup runs out); closed Mondays and irregular days
Address (JA): 京都府京都市左京区一乗寺西閉川原町29-7
Notes: Ultra-thick chicken paitan ("Toridaku"); Tabelog 3.74 and Ramen WEST 100 2025. No reservations: on busy days you take a queue ticket, and the shop closes once the soup sells out, so go early. In Japanese it's 麺屋極鶏.

Name: Chukasoba Takayasu
Address (JA): 京都府京都市左京区一乗寺高槻町10
Notes: An Ichijoji favorite since 1999, famous for its karaage set; #7 on Ramen WEST 100 2025.

Name: Tenten Yu
Hours: Mon–Sat 18:00–02:30; Sun and holidays 18:30–22:00; closed Wednesdays
Address (JA): 京都府京都市左京区一乗寺西杉ノ宮町49
Notes: A rich chicken-and-vegetable paitan shoyu ramen, served since 1971.

Name: Honke Daiichi Asahi
Address (JA): 京都府京都市下京区東塩小路向畑町845
Notes: Classic Kyoto shoyu-pork ramen since 1947 (Tabelog 3.74), open early enough for a breakfast bowl. Shinpuku Saikan, with its jet-black shoyu since 1938, is next door.

Name: Menya Inoichi
Address (JA): 京都府京都市下京区恵美須之町寺町通仏光寺下ル542
Notes: Michelin Bib Gourmand dashi ramen (kelp and seafood, no animal broth) topped with freshly shaved katsuobushi.

Name: Tsukemen Kirari
Hours: Lunch only, 11:00–14:30; closed Wednesdays and Thursdays
Address (JA): 京都府京都市伏見区東浜南町660-3
Notes: #1 on Tabelog Ramen WEST 100 2025, with just 11 seats; cash only. Three minutes from the north exit of Keihan Chushojima Station; pair it with a visit to the Fushimi sake breweries.

Name: Sumiyaki Sosai Toriya Hitomi
Address (JA): 京都府京都市左京区大菊町96
Notes: #2 on Tabelog Yakitori WEST 100 2025; Michelin Bib Gourmand. Mostly salt-seasoned, good value; book ahead. Closed Wednesdays.

Name: Wabiya Korekido
Hours: Lunch 11:30–14:00 (seatings at 11:30, 12:30 and 13:30), dinner 17:30–22:00; closed Sundays
Address (JA): ~京都府京都市東山区祇園町南側 四条花見小路下ル 歌舞練場北側
Notes: #4 on Tabelog Yakitori WEST 100 2025: oyakodon at lunch, yakitori at dinner. Seats can be booked on TableCheck.

Name: Tori Kago
Address (JA): ~京都府京都市中京区錦大宮町
Notes: An eight-seat modern yakitori omakase: 11 courses, beak to tail, for ¥15,000–20,000, and on Yakitori WEST 100. Reservations are essential.

Name: Baji Tofu
Address (JA): ~京都府京都市下京区真町
Notes: A central izakaya rated one of Kyoto's best for yakitori, on Yakitori WEST 100 2025. Book ahead.

Name: Gion Fuji
Address (JA): ~京都府京都市東山区宮川筋一丁目
Notes: #1 on Tabelog's national Tempura 100 2025, at ¥20,000–30,000. Book on TableCheck as early as you can.

Name: Tenjaku
Address (JA): 京都府京都市上京区牡丹鉾町570
Notes: Tempura kaiseki served family-style, ending with claypot rice; a Michelin star in 2026. Book on TableCheck, and look for the sign 天若 on Senbon-dori.

Name: Tempura Yoshikawa
Address (JA): ~京都府京都市中京区松下町
Notes: Tempura at a ryokan around a garden: counter at lunch, tatami rooms at dinner. Experienced with foreign guests.

Name: Gyoza Hohei Gion Honten
Address (JA): ~京都府京都市東山区宮川筋一丁目
Notes: Strongly garlicky gyoza, plus a ginger version with miso sauce; on Dumplings 100 2024.

Name: Motoi Gyoza
Address (JA): ~京都府京都市下京区長刀鉾町
Notes: Additive-free gyoza from the team behind Michelin-starred MOTOI; #12 on Dumplings 100 2024.

Name: Chao Chao
Address (JA): ~京都府京都市中京区石屋町
Notes: Popular gyoza bar with an 18cm "stick gyoza" plus cheese and shrimp versions. Part of an Osaka-based franchise.

Name: Gyoza no Ohsho
Address (JA): ~京都府京都市中京区錦大宮町
Notes: The first shop of Japan's biggest gyoza chain (1967). Visit as a curiosity, not for the best gyoza.

Name: Jukusei Buta Kawamura
Address (JA): ~京都府京都市山科区竹鼻西ノ口町
Notes: Aged-pork specialist and Kyoto's top-rated tonkatsu (Tabelog 3.76). East of the center, near Keihan Yamashina.

Name: Kyogoku Kaneyo
Address (JA): ~京都府京都市中京区松ケ枝町
Notes: Famous kinshi-don: a thick Kyoto dashimaki omelette over eel and rice; Michelin Bib Gourmand. Old-Kyoto atmosphere.

Name: Kanesho
Hours: Lunch 11:30–14:00, dinner 17:30–22:00; closed Thursdays and Sundays
Address (JA): 京都府京都市東山区常盤町155-2
Notes: Michelin Bib Gourmand 2026, down a narrow alley; kinshi-don and eel ochazuke.

Name: Unagiya Hirokawa
Address (JA): ~京都府京都市右京区嵯峨天龍寺北造路町
Notes: Arashiyama's famous eel house (Tabelog 3.72). Reserve by phone; walk-in lines can take hours.

Name: Shinya Yakiniku Daichan
Address (JA): ~京都府京都市下京区真町
Notes: Kyoto's top-rated yakiniku on Tabelog (4.31, Tabelog Award 2026 Bronze), at ¥20,000–30,000. A hidden late-night shop that takes bookings by DM.

Name: Aje Matsubara Honten
Address (JA): ~京都府京都市東山区宮川筋八丁目
Notes: A value pick known for horumon (offal), at ¥4,000–5,000; Tabelog 3.65.

Name: Mishima-tei
Address (JA): ~京都府京都市中京区桜之町
Notes: Founded 1873; aged whole-cattle beef cooked in tallow with coarse sugar, served in a Meiji-era townhouse. Closed Tuesdays.

Name: Morita-ya
Address (JA): ~京都府京都市中京区下丸屋町
Notes: A sukiyaki house since 1869, overlooking the Kamo River: sukiyaki with Kujo negi for ¥6,000–8,000. On Hot Pot 100 2024.

Name: Junidanya Honten
Address (JA): ~京都府京都市東山区祇園町南側
Notes: Its beef mizutaki is said to be the origin of shabu-shabu. Closed Wednesdays and Thursdays.

Name: Sukiyaki Kimura
Address (JA): ~京都府京都市中京区東大文字町
Notes: Cook-it-yourself shop from 1932; wagyu sukiyaki lunch from about ¥2,000. Closed Mondays.

Name: Fruit Parlor Yaoiso
Address (JA): ~京都府京都市下京区立中町
Notes: Kyoto's classic for fruit sandwiches (strawberry among them) and mixed juice.

Name: Mizuno
Address (JA): 大阪府大阪市中央区道頓堀1-4-15
Notes: Family-run okonomiyaki since 1945: order the Mizuno-yaki or the airy yamaimo-yaki. Michelin Bib Gourmand. No reservations, so come at opening on a weekday.

Name: Kiji
Hours: 11:30–21:30 (last order); closed Sundays (also Obon and New Year)
Address (JA): 大阪府大阪市北区角田町9-20 新梅田食道街
Notes: Bib Gourmand; known for ooba (shiso) okonomiyaki and modanyaki. Constant queues; closed Sundays. Kiji Sky in the Umeda Sky Building is smaller.

Name: Negiyaki Yamamoto
Address (JA): 大阪府大阪市淀川区十三本町1-8-4
Notes: Considered the originator of negiyaki; get the suji-negi (beef tendon and konjac) with lemon. Okonomiyaki 100 #10.

Name: Okonomi Tamachan Viva
Address (JA): 大阪府大阪市西区北堀江2-3-10 TSUJIビルディング1F
Notes: Tabelog 3.65 and Okonomiyaki 100; popular with travelers. Reservations possible.

Name: Hozenji Sanpei
Hours: 17:00–23:00; Saturdays, Sundays and holidays also 11:30–15:30; closed Tuesdays
Address (JA): 大阪府大阪市中央区道頓堀1-7-10
Notes: 40+ years in the atmospheric Hozenji alley; fluffy suji-negi okonomiyaki. Closed Tuesdays.

Name: Ganso Kushikatsu Daruma Shinsekai Sohonten
Hours: Weekdays 11:00–22:30; Saturdays, Sundays and holidays 10:30–22:30 (last order 22:00); no closed days
Address (JA): 大阪府大阪市浪速区恵美須東2-3-9
Notes: Founding store of Daruma (1929), where the no-double-dipping rule started. Weekdays 2:30–5pm to beat the line.

Name: Yaekatsu
Hours: 10:30–21:00 (last order 20:45); closed Thursdays and the 3rd Wednesday
Address (JA): 大阪府大阪市浪速区恵美須東3-4-13
Notes: Since 1949; the locals' Shinsekai classic. Budget-friendly; queues at peak times.

Name: Tengu
Address (JA): ~大阪府大阪市浪速区恵美須東三丁目
Notes: Crunchy-battered kushikatsu plus doteyaki (beef tendon in white miso). A good backup when the line at Daruma is long.

Name: Kushikatsu Bon
Address (JA): 大阪府大阪市北区堂島1-3-16 堂島メリーセンタービル地下1階
Notes: Refined kushiage course (about 20 skewers, ~¥14,000) with uni and caviar bites and a katsu sando to finish. Reserve.

Name: Rokukakutei Kuromon Honten
Address (JA): ~大阪府大阪市中央区日本橋一丁目
Notes: Chef's-choice kushiage course using seasonal Kuromon Market produce, with sommelier-picked wines. Reserve.

Name: Musubiya
Address (JA): ~大阪府大阪市中央区谷町六丁目
Notes: Onigiri from a former rice shop that puts rice quality first: try the beef tendon, the clam or the mentaiko-salmon.

Name: Jinrui Mina Menrui
Address (JA): ~大阪府大阪市淀川区西中島一丁目
Notes: Hugely popular shoyu ramen with extra-thick chashu; Tabelog 3.75, Ramen OSAKA 100. Open until 3–4am; cash only.

Name: Kadoya Shokudo Sohonten
Address (JA): ~大阪府大阪市西区新町四丁目
Notes: A leader of Osaka's ramen boom; known for chukasoba. Ramen OSAKA 100 2025.

Name: Mugi to Mensuke
Address (JA): 大阪府大阪市北区豊崎3-4-12
Notes: Michelin Bib Gourmand ramen since 2020, so there's almost always a line. Four minutes from Nakatsu Station.

Name: Torisho Ishii
Address (JA): ~大阪府大阪市北区天神橋二丁目
Notes: Yakitori omakase blended with high-end Japanese cooking, with a Michelin star in 2024; it's known for its chicken burger. Its offshoot Ishii Jr. (Bib Gourmand) is the cheaper way in.

Name: Ayamuya
Address (JA): ~大阪府大阪市福島区福島五丁目
Notes: Yakitori from Tamba chicken; order the signature tsukune. Michelin Bib Gourmand.

Name: Sumibiyakitori Ikoka
Address (JA): 大阪府大阪市中央区大手通3-3-3
Notes: Reasonably priced charcoal yakitori with a Michelin Bib Gourmand; order the tsukune and the sasami. There's a separate branch in Nishitemma.

Name: Tempura Hiraishi
Address (JA): ~大阪府大阪市北区曾根崎新地一丁目
Notes: Michelin-starred tempura at a 10-seat counter, about ¥22,000 with wine pairings. Book ahead.

Name: Tenboshi
Address (JA): ~大阪府大阪市北区天神橋六丁目
Notes: Casual counter tempura with a 2026 Bib Gourmand: the inexpensive way to eat top Osaka tempura.

Name: Tenpei Kitashinchi Honten
Address (JA): 大阪府大阪市北区曽根崎新地1-8-12
Notes: Claims to have invented Osaka's bite-size gyoza; Dumplings 100 (#6). 15–20 piece minimum plus a drink; closed Sundays.

Name: Tenshin no Kimochi
Address (JA): ~大阪府大阪市大正区三軒家西一丁目
Notes: Additive-free gyoza with house-made wrappers; Dumplings 100 2024 (#3). Off the tourist routes.

Name: New Babe
Address (JA): ~大阪府大阪市中央区谷町四丁目
Notes: One of Osaka's best tonkatsu shops: Tabelog 3.71 and Tonkatsu 100 2026.

Name: Honke Shibato
Address (JA): ~大阪府大阪市中央区高麗橋二丁目
Notes: About 300 years old; Kansai-style eel (split along the belly and grilled directly, no steaming, so it's crisp). Compare it with Tokyo's steamed style.

Name: Tsunechan
Address (JA): 大阪府堺市堺区御陵通4-7 和伸ビル1F
Notes: Osaka's top-rated yakiniku on Tabelog (4.21, Tabelog Award 2026 Bronze), at ¥15,000–20,000. Reservations are online only, and everyone at a seating starts together, so be on time. It's in Sakai, a ten-minute walk from Goryomae Station.

Name: Kyoshoran
Hours: Tue-Fri 18:00-22:30; Sat, Sun, holidays 17:30-22:30; usually closed Mondays
Address (JA): 大阪府大阪市都島区片町2-11-22 京橋ROOBO 4F
Notes: Mid-range yakiniku at ¥8,000–10,000, with Tabelog 3.91 and a place on Grill WEST 100 2026. Book online; the name is written 京松蘭.

Name: Yakiniku Masachiyan
Hours: Tue–Sat from 17:00; closed Sundays, Mondays, and all of August and September
Address (JA): 大阪府大阪市西成区鶴見橋3-8-21
Notes: A value pick for yakiniku at ¥6,000–8,000, Tabelog 3.82. Reservations only, no walk-ins, and only customers the shop approves can book.

Name: Hariju
Hours: Sukiyaki restaurant: lunch 11:30-15:30 (LO 14:30), dinner 17:00-21:00 (LO 20:00); closed Tuesdays (open holidays and all December)
Address (JA): 大阪府大阪市中央区道頓堀1-9-17
Notes: A butcher and sukiyaki house since 1919, serving aged female Kuroge wagyu.

Name: Yamaguchi Kudamono
Address (JA): 大阪府大阪市中央区上本町西2-1-9 宏栄ビル1F
Notes: Osaka's top-rated fruit parlor (Tabelog 3.65): parfaits, kakigori and juice. It also trades as FRUIT GARDEN 山口果物, a five-minute walk from Tanimachi 6-chome Station.

Name: Parfaiteria PaL
Hours: Mon-Thu 17:00-24:00; Fri and day before holidays 17:00-01:00; Sat 15:00-01:00; Sun and holidays 15:00-24:00
Address (JA): 大阪府大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-17-15 丸清ビル3F
Notes: A night-parfait specialist (Tabelog 100 2026), with strawberries in its winter parfaits. You can book online.

Name: Kakinoha-zushi Honpo Tanaka
Address (JA): 奈良県奈良市東向中町5-2
Notes: Kakinoha-zushi as eat-in lunch sets (limited each day) or boxed to take away. The easiest option near Kintetsu-Nara, right at the entrance to the Higashimuki arcade.

Name: Izasa Nakatani Honpo
Hours: 1F takeaway 10:00-17:00; 2F restaurant (ゐざさ茶屋) 11:00-17:00, LO 16:00. Closed on listed dates (November: 10, 16, 24, 30)
Address (JA): 奈良県奈良市春日野町16 東大寺門前夢風ひろば内
Notes: Takeaway on the ground floor; upstairs, the restaurant serves kakinoha-zushi and Miwa somen with views of Todaiji. Arrive early, and check the shop's page for its closed dates, posted monthly.

Name: Hiraso
Hours: Main building shop 10:00-20:30; annex dining 11:30-20:00 (LO 20:00); closed Mondays; hours vary by season
Address (JA): 奈良県奈良市今御門町30-1
Notes: One of the oldest kakinoha-zushi makers, from Yoshino and some 150 years old; the renovated restaurant also serves chagayu and tempura. It runs kakinoha-zushi-making workshops, and takes lunch bookings only for groups of ten or more.

Name: Kamameshi Shizuka
Hours: Mon, Wed-Fri 11:00-15:00; Sat, Sun 11:00-16:00; closed Tuesdays
Address (JA): 奈良県奈良市登大路町59-11
Notes: 60+ years; each pot cooked to order over an open flame, giving a crispy okoge crust. Closed Tuesdays.

Name: Tou no Chaya
Hours: 11:30-15:30 (may close around 14:00 if ingredients run out); dinner by reservation only (kaiseki); closed Tuesdays
Address (JA): 奈良県奈良市南城戸町18
Notes: Nara's tea-rice porridge specialist, for a chagayu bento or kaiseki. Book ahead: the shop asks for lunch bookings in advance, and dinner is a kaiseki by reservation only.

Name: Sabo Non-non
Hours: Tue-Fri 11:30-14:00; Sat, Sun 11:00-14:00; closed Mondays (open if a holiday)
Address (JA): 奈良県奈良市西新屋町43 奈良オリエント館内
Notes: A chagayu set served in the tatami room of a machiya some 180 years old.

Name: Ajitei Yamazakiya
Address (JA): 奈良県奈良市東向南町5
Notes: The restaurant of a Narazuke pickle maker: a hojicha chagayu set with pickles, plus kakinoha-zushi.

Name: Menya Bibiri
Hours: Daily 11:00-15:00 and 18:00-21:00; closed dinner on the last day of each month and Jan 1
Address (JA): 奈良県奈良市七条町165-1
Notes: A casual counter serving fish-and-chicken soba and mazesoba; #13 on Ramen WEST 100 2025. Eight minutes on foot from Kujo Station.

Name: Yakitori Mochizuki
Address (JA): 奈良県奈良市杉ケ町32-14
Notes: A yakitori set course over binchotan, from whole birds butchered in-house; Michelin-listed in 2026 and #20 on Yakitori WEST 100. Reservations only, and Tabelog bookings take at most two people.

Name: Tempura Hattori
Address (JA): 奈良県奈良市大森町23-1
Notes: Omakase tempura from a ryotei-trained chef, ending with tencha; Michelin-listed in 2026. Booking is online only, and it's cash only.

Name: Seikoudoku
Address (JA): 京都府宇治市宇治池森20-1
Notes: Homemade flat noodles in a soupless sesame-miso tantanmen; #19 on Ramen WEST 100 2025. Expect a line: bookings open at midnight the day before, and walk-ins are given an estimated time. A 15-minute walk from JR Uji Station.

Name: Yubadon Naokichi
Address (JA): 神奈川県足柄下郡箱根町湯本696
Notes: Yuba-don: housemade yuba cooked with egg in a clay pot, served over rice. Five minutes from the station.

Name: Tamura Ginkatsutei
Hours: Mon, Thu-Sun 11:00-14:30 and 17:00-19:00; Tue 11:00-14:30; closed Wednesdays
Address (JA): 神奈川県足柄下郡箱根町強羅1300-739
Notes: Hakone's famous tofu katsu-ni (tofu with pork and egg, simmered in a clay pot), served since 1973. A minute from Gora Station; expect a queue.
